name: @atropical/stroq-studio-mcp

tools.name: studio_connection
tools.description: Whether a Strōq World Studio tab is connected to this relay. When none is, it gives the pairing string (port:TOKEN) to tell the person: in the Studio, Tools → AI agent → Connect…, paste it, switch Connect on. The Studio tools appear once the tab connects.

tools.name: wait_for_comments
tools.description: Waits for comments and Asks from the person in the Studio and returns them; works before the tab has paired too (it waits for the pairing first). Returns within 45 s; "nothing new" means call it again. Use it as a loop: handle each one (ack_comment, get_comment, do the work, reply_comment), then call wait_for_comments again. Keep calling it even if the tab disconnects (it resumes by itself); only stop when the person tells you to.

instructions: Tools of an open Strōq World Studio tab, relayed. If no tab is connected yet, call studio_connection and tell the person the pairing string (port:TOKEN) to paste under Tools → AI agent → Connect…. This agent owns the Studio's comments and Asks, and the person expects answers without prompting you again: Call wait_for_comments, and keep calling it in a loop: each call returns within about 50 s, either with the comments and Asks waiting (for each: ack_comment straight away, get_comment for the picture and thread, do the work, reply_comment saying what changed) or with "nothing new", and then you call it again. Keep calling it even if the Studio tab disconnects or reloads (it resumes by itself); only stop when the person tells you to. Every Studio model has four levels: High, Far (a thinned copy), Baked and Low-poly style (flat-coloured, ~0.3–2k triangles, no textures). When you create a model for the Studio, make and send all you can (import_model_file highPath, farPath, lowPolyStylePath; the Studio bakes the Baked level), tell the person which levels the Studio made automatically and ask them to approve or supply them, and never show the person temporary file paths.
